_comment: 919,172 params at n_stages 4, on the full 6-task suite at k in
{0,1,2,3,5,8}, 576 held-out instances per eval pass. This is the ordered
half of the pair that decides whether the role diagnostic's premise holds.
Run both arms together so the isolation check runs:
arm_compare refuses to compare arms differing by more than
stop.act.shuffle_train. Do not work around that refusal; a comparison that
isolates nothing looks exactly as clean as one that does.
eval_max_new is 16, not 64: the targets here are 8-20 chars and 64 only
buys decode time. eval_every is effectively off because the final eval is
AUTO-BATCH IS ON for throughput. It preserves the effective batch via
accumulation compensation, so the arms stay comparable with each other, but
neither is comparable with a fixed-batch run.
